title: Operator-deployed ToyOS mainline bundle must preempt generic goal backlog
problem: Freshly deployed ToyOS mainline goals remained planned because generic running/planned goals with equal or higher score consumed the limited goal scan window and dispatch slot.
symptoms: ToyOS goals exist and compile to ready graphs but no tasks are created.
brain_loop actions show unrelated goals being scanned first.
A stale running goal or generic release backlog monopolizes dispatch budget.
rule: When explicit ToyOS mainline goals are pending or planned and there is no active ToyOS mainline task, reorder the goal scan to put ToyOS mainline goals first before generic backlog.

implementation.brain_loop: Prioritize ToyOS mainline goals ahead of generic active goals when no ToyOS task is active.
implementation.blocked_goal_handling: Auto-hold running goals whose linked tasks are terminal without active work.

validation: Blocked goal goal_23a99eee18 transitioned to on_hold with runtime_hold metadata.
ToyOS goals began dispatching architecture-contract tasks after prioritization.
